title: Academic setup
description: Set up how each grade is graded for an academic year, from subjects and weights to final results and certificates.
noYearsHint: Create an academic year first, then come back to set up its grading.
yearsError: Unable to load the academic years.

retakePolicy.capped: Retake counts up to a cap

issues.TERM_CATEGORY_WEIGHT_TOTAL: Term category weights total {{total}}%; they must total 100%.
issues.ANNUAL_WEIGHT_TOTAL: Term weights plus whole-year category weights total {{total}}%; they must total 100%.
issues.MAX_MARKS_INVALID: Maximum marks must be greater than 0.
issues.PASS_PERCENTAGE_INVALID: The passing percentage must be between 0 and 100.
issues.FINAL_EXAM_PASS_PERCENTAGE_INVALID: The final exam passing percentage must be between 0 and 100.
issues.ROUNDING_DECIMALS_INVALID: Rounding must keep between 0 and 4 decimal places.
issues.RETAKE_CAP_REQUIRED: A capped retake policy needs a cap between 0 and 100%.
issues.NO_CATEGORIES: Add at least one assessment category.
issues.TERM_WEIGHT_MISSING: There are term categories, but no term carries any weight in the year's grade.
issues.TERM_WEIGHT_WITHOUT_TERM_CATEGORIES: Terms carry weight, but there are no term categories to build a term grade from.
issues.WEIGHT_IGNORED_FOR_TOTAL_POINTS: Category weights are ignored when the subject is graded by total points.
issues.FINAL_EXAM_RULE_WITHOUT_FINAL: The final exam must be passed on its own, but no category is a final exam.

statusHelp.draft: Draft: rules can be changed freely and teachers can't enter marks yet. Publish when the checklist is done.
statusHelp.active: Published: teachers enter marks. Rule changes that affect recorded marks need confirmation.
statusHelp.finalized: Finalized: the rules are locked. Results can still be corrected and certificates issued.

overview.publishDescription: Teachers can start entering marks once the year is published.
overview.publishBlocked: Fix the problems below before publishing.

draft.title: Move back to draft?
draft.description: Only possible while no marks have been recorded. Teachers lose access to mark entry until you publish again.

finalized.title: Finalize the year's grading?
finalized.description: Rules are locked for good. Make sure every section's results are finalized first.

archived.title: Archive this year?
archived.description: The year becomes read-only. Certificates stay available.

start.title: Start the year's configuration
start.help: Copy last year's set-up, or start from scratch by setting up a grade.

grades.title: Set up grades and a grading scale
grades.help: Add the year's grading scale and set each grade's policies.

subjects.title: Add subjects and grading rules
subjects.help: Each grade's subjects, categories, weights and assessments. Every section inherits them.

sections.title: Review sections
sections.help: Customize or exclude subjects for individual sections, and resolve outdated overrides.

teachers.title: Assign teachers
teachers.help: Every subject in every section needs a teacher to enter marks.

publish.title: Publish
publish.help: Publishing checks everything above and opens mark entry to teachers.

overview.noGrades: No grades are set up for this year yet.

copy.description: Copies grading scales, grade policies, subjects with their rules, and sections.
copy.neverCopied: Marks, results and certificates are never copied.
copy.done: The configuration was copied. Review it before publishing.
